title: One Thing Promise
equation: Market Pull = Customer Pain × Promise Clarity × Delivery Consistency
hook: If your customer can't say why they picked you in one sentence, you've got too many promises.
statement: The strongest businesses organize around the one outcome customers care about most.
explainer: A feature is what you do. Value is the result they get. If you help agents save a day a week, build everything around that, not ten vague benefits. A clear promise is easier to sell and deliver.
sop: List every reason customers buy from you.
Find the one they'd miss most if it disappeared.
Turn that into one clear promise.
Score Customer Pain, Promise Clarity, and Delivery Consistency from 1 to 10.
Cut anything in marketing or delivery that doesn't support it.
equation_example: Customer Pain 9, Promise Clarity 5, Delivery Consistency 7. 9 × 5 × 7 = 315 Market Pull, out of 1,000. Higher means people come to you without heavy persuading. Lower means they forget why they should choose you.
question: Write the one result your customers value most from you in a single sentence.
closing_statement: Clarity beats being everything to everyone.
caption:
Principle Nº 247: One Thing Promise
